ideas.pitch: An affordable AI garbage classification system using Python, OpenCV, and Arduino that automatically detects and segregates wet and dry waste.
ideas.title: SmartBin AI Segregator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly builds on proven robotics classification projects from previous hackathons and focuses on waste collection and segregation, a core track.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered IoT sensor network using TypeScript and anomaly detection to monitor urban drainage blockage and overflow risks in real-time.
ideas.title: DrainSentry IoT Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hard IoT engineering with measurable environmental impact, matching the drain monitoring track.

ideas.pitch: Using satellite imagery and computer vision to automatically detect illegal open garbage dumps and overflowing community bins across Indian cities.
ideas.title: GeoTrash Satellite Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages satellite monitoring patterns that have won major infrastructure hackathons previously.

ideas.pitch: A mobile web app that rewards citizens with tokens for reporting uncleared garbage spots and participating in neighborhood cleanup drives.
ideas.title: CivicClean Walk-to-Earn
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts a winning real-world impact civic tech model into an engaging civic education platform.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first AI recommendation platform connecting municipal waste aggregators with recycling plants for raw material exchange.
ideas.title: CircularMatch B2B Waste Marketplace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the recycling and circular economy track with a clear economic and environmental quantifiable benefit.
